subject: Azure Partner Center referral — Contoso intake & consent flow
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Partner Center referral — Contoso intake & consent flow

Hi Amanda —

Great to connect last week at the Azure partner briefing. As discussed, we want to make the Partner Center referral and seller consent steps as lightweight as possible so your field sellers can quickly hand off leads to Redwood with minimal friction.

Attached is a one-page intake flow (rdw_referral-intake-flow_v1.pdf) that we use internally; it lays out the recommended step-by-step for seller capture, consent, and account mapping. Quick asks:

- Can you confirm whether Contoso requires the seller to fill out a consent form vs. accepting via Partner Center?
- Do you have an internal owner mapping file (CSV) we can align on for account deduping?
- Who should we loop in from Contoso GTM for the HubSpot sync (we plan to push a Deal/Contact reference back into your system)?

If you’re available tomorrow at 10am PT I can walk the team through the intake flow and a proposed mapping heuristic for contested accounts.

Thanks — looking forward to ironing this out.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0129
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rdw_referral-intake-flow_v1.pdf
From: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@contoso.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contoso GTM <contoso-gtm@microsoft.com>, contoso-cloud-ops@contoso.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center referral — Contoso intake & consent flow

Vivek —

Thanks for the note and the flow doc. Quick answers:

- Contoso prefers Partner Center seller consent where possible, but for large accounts we ask for a written acknowledgment (email is fine).
- I attached an export of our current account owner roster (see contoso_account-mapping_draft.xlsx). It’s not perfect — there are duplicates and a few legacy tenant IDs — but it should be a good starting point.
- Please include Sarah Park (sarah.park@contoso.com) from GTM; she owns partner handoffs in EMEAR, and we’ll route US/Canada to James Ortiz (james.ortiz@contoso.com).

10am PT tomorrow works for me. I’ll bring Sarah and James on the invite.

—Amanda
Amanda Liu
Partner Programs, Contoso Cloud
Attachments: contoso_account-mapping_draft.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@contoso.com>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@contoso.com>, James Ortiz <james.ortiz@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center referral — Contoso intake & consent flow

Thanks Amanda — appreciate the fast turnaround and the mapping file. I took a quick pass and attached a cleaned-up draft with suggested owner-normalization rules (contoso_account-mapping_draft.xlsx -> cleaned tab). Key notes below before tomorrow’s call:

- Heuristic: Prefer explicit Azure seller email match -> then LinkedIn owner -> then territory assignment file. We flag ambiguous matches for manual review.
- Consent: We can support Partner Center-native consent but recommend an email acknowledgment for any account > $250k ARR in year 1. We’ll auto-populate the DocuSign template if you want a signed record.
- HubSpot sync: we will push a Deal record with HubSpot ID back to your GTM email via a webhook. We’ll need your HubSpot portal ID and the field mapping for owner_email -> owner_id.

Agenda for 30-min call (10:00am PT):
1) Walk intake flow and required fields (5 min)
2) Mapping heuristic and contested-account escalation (10 min)
3) Consent options and DocuSign template review (10 min)
4) Next steps and rollout timeline (5 min)

Attached: cleaned mapping draft + consent-email-templates.docx. See you tomorrow.

Vivek
Attachments: contoso_account-mapping_draft.xlsx, consent-email-templates.docx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: Azure Partner Center referral — Contoso intake & consent flow

Forwarding the Contoso mapping and notes from the kickoff. Key internal ops items for our side before the call:

- Karthik: please review the cleaned mapping tab and confirm the owner normalization SQL (I sketched a template in column H). We need a snippet we can run to detect duplicates across tenant_id/email/alias.
- Laura: prepare HubSpot field mapping document + list of required webhooks. HubSpot portal ID is in the linked HubSpot record (https://hubspot.example/contacts/CTSO-4567).
- I’ll prepare a one-slide intake checklist we can use when training AMs — will drop in the Drive folder.

Vanessa
Head of Field GTM Ops, Redwood Inference

> 1) We’re fine using Partner Center consent for the majority of referrals. For strategic accounts we’ll do the DocuSign route.
> 2) Attached is a short list of 12 priority accounts we want Richmond AMs to route to Redwood immediately (see attached list in Drive).

We’re comfortable to pilot the intake over the next 4 weeks. Please send the final intake checklist and the HubSpot webhook spec before EOD Monday and we’ll set the pilot start date.

Amanda
